the_wire_fix.diagnosis: two credential layers diverged: discovery_fabric/engine/llm_registry.py reads ENV VARS (ATRIA_API_KEY* via key_env_vars — why the atria leg served every run since R480), while discovery_fabric/source_registry/keys.py, discovery_fabric/prior_art_v2/sources.py and toscanini/gateway.py read the .env.keys FILE — excluded from the image by .dockerignore (correct, S-01) and never materialized; sources.py additionally hardcoded a sandbox-era path (/home/z/my-project/discovery-evidence-fabric/.env.keys) that cannot exist in any container. Net effect, measured live in R490: 5/10 collision legs failed LENS_API_TOKEN-not-configured while the env layer served the same run. Registering secrets WITHOUT this fix would have been a no-op (the BS-003 class: set but never wired).
